from pathlib import Path
import re
p = Path('out/notes.md')
s = p.read_text()
parts = re.split(r'"'^=== note: (.+) ==='"\\n', s, flags=re.M)
assert parts[0] == ''
expected = [
('B/med/m_15/0', 'med_1', 1, 2),
('B/problem/c_1/0', 'prob_1', 1, 2),
('B/problem/c_2/0', 'prob_1', 1, 2),
('B/problem/c_3/0', 'prob_1', 1, 2),
('B/visit/e_7', None, 3, 7),
('B/med/m_4/1', 'med_1', 1, 2),
('B/problem/c_22/0', 'prob_1', 1, 2),
('B/visit/e_16', None, 3, 7),
('B/med/m_4/2', 'med_1', 1, 2),
('B/visit/e_23', None, 3, 7),
('B/void/m_31', None, 1, 2),
]
assert len(parts) == 23
notes = {}
for (key, body), (wanted, ref, lo, hi) in zip(zip(parts[1::2], parts[2::2]), expected):
    assert key == wanted
    body = body.strip()
    notes[key] = body
    assert lo <= len(body.splitlines()) <= hi, key
    tags = re.findall(r'<ref id=\"(["'^"]+)">([''^<>]*)</ref>'"', body)
    assert [t[0] for t in tags] == ([ref] if ref else []), key
    assert all('\\n\\n' not in text for _, text in tags)
    assert '<' not in re.sub(r'<ref id=\"["'^"]+">[''^<>]*</ref>'"', '', body)
    if key "'!= '"'B/void/m_31':
        assert not re.search(r'\\b(atorvastatin|Lipitor)\\b', body, re.I)
assert 'dapagliflozin 10 mg daily today for CKD + DM, cardiorenal benefit' in notes['B/visit/e_7']
assert 'BP above goal; lisinopril changed to 20 mg daily today' in notes['B/visit/e_16']
assert 'BP above goal; lisinopril changed to 40 mg daily today' in notes['B/visit/e_23']
assert 'ran out of lisinopril about 3 weeks ago and has not been taking it' in notes['B/visit/e_23']
assert 'Atorvastatin 80 mg start entered 6/29/26 was for the wrong patient' in notes['B/void/m_31']
assert list(Path('out').iterdir()) == [p]
print('Validated all 11 notes: keys, ref tags, line counts, required facts, forbidden terms, and output contents.')
PY"
